title: Glass Linn Shimmer
prompt: dance pop in the style of the band big sis
description: Crisp LinnDrum patterns anchor a C-minor pentatonic triangle-wave melody that shimmers with delay and subtle octave harmonics, building from a sparse rhythmic sketch through a richly percussive peak section dense with rims, percs, and open hats. A brief, hazy breakdown strips the arrangement before the drums and melody reassemble for one final full-band push.

setcpm(116/4)
arrange(
